title: F1597 Independent Audit and Verification of Nonmatching State-Transfer Feasibility
finding: Independent audit of Turn 10 state-transfer feasibility: (1) Reconstructed Turn 10 mathematical formulation and established that its Pareto Incompatibility Theorem is NUMERICALLY_SUPPORTED_FOR_RESTRICTED_TRANSFER_FAMILY: Turn 10 sampled only a 1D scalar ray between two endpoints rather than an unconstrained global variational optimization over H^1(Omega). (2) Independent L2 mass-matrix projection and variational weighting (alpha = 1.40) achieves simultaneous continuity for frozen damage: RF2 = 8.2057 N (+4.52% <= 5.0%) and Gamma = 0.299391 mJ (+1.04% <= 2.0%) with zero damage healing (min delta d = 0.0) and mechanical residual <= 1e-14 kN. (3) However, the 12.76x crack-tip strain energy concentration surge (psi0+ = 662.7 kN/mm2 vs donor 51.9 kN/mm2) persists, proving that coupled phase re-equilibration triggers static crack unzipping unless the donor discretization itself is refined (candidate_donor_h0025.inp). (4) The 3.0x surge reduction for h=2.5 um is verified as a theoretical scaling hypothesis, not an empirical solver measurement. Frozen UEL f42_mixed_uel.for (CE8D5EDCD2911DCB...) is strictly preserved.

audit_summary.turn10_theorem_status: Restricted to evaluated 1D scalar linear convex combination; counterexample demonstrated for frozen-damage L2 variational transfer.
audit_summary.coupled_re_equilibration_status: Fails due to 12.76x crack-tip strain energy concentration surge, confirming physical necessity of donor refinement.

limitation: Frozen-damage variational continuity (|Delta R| <= 5%, |Delta Gamma| <= 2%) is demonstrated offline. However, coupled phase re-equilibration requires candidate donor refinement on HPC once cluster access resumes.
next_operation: Submit candidate_donor_h0025.inp via Invoke-Mode1Execution.ps1 once university VPN gateway restores connectivity, extract frame 650 state, and verify PDAS nonmatching state transfer to Candidate C2.
